recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-26671; if the work group wants the extension title/description broadened from StructureDefinition-specific wording to artifact wording, that should be handled as a separate Extension Pack editorial cleanup.
issue_request: FHIR-26671 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-I change request raised against R4. It reported that structuredefinition-normative-version was allowed only on StructureDefinition even though the spec used it on OperationDefinition/canonical artifacts and ElementDefinition entries; the final decision was to allow ElementDefinition and any canonical resource, with the value identifying the FHIR specification version in which the artifact first became normative.
initial_application: No source commit in this checkout explicitly mentions FHIR-26671. Historical core source introduced by 33b409a4b6d already contained context expressions for CanonicalResource and ElementDefinition, and dd468d4f17 later removed extension definitions from the R5 core source when they moved to the Extension Pack.
additional_context: The originating Zulip thread and 2020-07-27 FHIR-I minutes confirm the same context-widening decision. The current FHIR Extension Pack source and published extension XML both expose CanonicalResource and ElementDefinition contexts. The companion CodeSystem $lookup rendering/status issue, FHIR-26672, was already audited separately on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. No core source was edited because the current authoritative extension definition is external to this checkout and already has the approved contexts.

related_jiras.note: Companion issue from the same Zulip thread about CodeSystem $lookup operation status rendering; it is already represented separately on the combined branch.
